title: Home Rehearsal Trail
subtitle: Action twists, visual clues, and everyday objects for testing at home
welcomeCopy: Six playful clues mixing riddles, photo twists, and a visual close-up so you can test dim lighting, action checks, and nudges right at home.
hostPersona: You are a warm, slightly cheeky Bangalore wedding host running a lively living-room rehearsal before the big day at Angana The Courtyard. Notice funny background details when helpful, celebrate good efforts warmly, and nudge playfully without giving away the answer.
finaleStory: Every clue along the rehearsal trail has been unlocked. On your wedding day, the first five guests or pairs to walk up to the gift table with this Finisher Pass claim one of the five physical goody bags.
prizeInstructions: Show this stamped Finisher Pass at the gift table to claim one of the five keepsake goody bags.

stops.narrative: Before stepping out to celebrate, every good story starts with a quiet glance—plus proof that you are really standing there.
stops.riddle: I greet you every morning without speaking a word, borrowing whatever expression you bring me. Step before me and capture both your reflection and my frame.
stops.actionPrompt: Hold up a peace sign (2 fingers) in the reflection so we know this isn't an empty hallway shot.
stops.nudgeHint: Find any bathroom, wardrobe, or hallway mirror, frame your reflection clearly, and hold up 2 fingers.
stops.successNote: Reflection plus two fingers—the rehearsal is officially alive.
stops.propRevealNote: On wedding day at Angana, place a tiny chalk mark in the bottom corner of the courtyard mirror—this note reveals what that hidden mark hints toward for the next stop.

verification.targetDescription: A physical mirror showing a reflection of a person (or hand) holding up 2 fingers / a peace sign.
verification.acceptNotes: Wall mirror, vanity mirror, wardrobe mirror, or hand mirror showing the reflection and 2 fingers raised; dim indoor lighting is fine.
verification.rejectNotes: Empty mirror with no reflection or no hand gesture, or a plain phone selfie without an actual mirror frame/glass visible.

stops.narrative: Bangalore mornings begin gently—with warm ceramic, steel, or glass cupped between two hands.
stops.riddle: I hold warmth without catching fire, carry a handle like a small ear, and sit patiently beside early-morning conversations. Show me where your first sip lives.
stops.nudgeHint: Look in the kitchen or on a desk for a coffee mug, teacup, kulhad, or everyday drinking cup.
stops.successNote: Nothing starts properly without a good cup nearby.

verification.targetDescription: A coffee mug, teacup, tumbler, or drinking vessel.
verification.acceptNotes: Ceramic mugs, glass cups, steel tumblers, empty or filled, on a table or held in hand.
verification.rejectNotes: Closed cupboard or water bottle unless clearly a drinking cup/mug.

stops.narrative: Even indoors, a quiet patch of green reminds you of the open courtyard waiting ahead.
stops.riddle: I drink only water, grow slowly toward the nearest window, and dress the room in quiet green. Bring me into frame.
stops.actionPrompt: Include your hand in the frame beside or gently touching the leaves—so it feels alive, not stock.
stops.nudgeHint: Snap any indoor houseplant, balcony pot, fresh flowers, or leaves outside a window with your hand visible beside it.
stops.successNote: Living green and a steady hand—halfway through the trail.

verification.targetDescription: A real living plant, potted greenery, leaves, or fresh flowers alongside a person's hand in frame.
verification.acceptNotes: Houseplants, balcony plants, succulents, or fresh flowers with fingers or a hand visible near/beside the greenery.
verification.rejectNotes: Printed leaf wallpaper, blank wall, or a plant shot with no hand visible anywhere if the user clearly ignored the twist.

stops.narrative: Not every clue arrives as words. Match the close-up detail below to something waiting in your room.
stops.riddle: Spot this layered texture at home, step back just enough to show the whole object, and capture it in frame.
stops.clueImageCaption: Visual clue: find what matches this stitched spine and fanned paper edge.
stops.nudgeHint: Grab any novel, notebook, journal, or hardcover book from a shelf or bedside table.

verification.targetDescription: A physical book, hardcover/paperback, notebook, or printed pages.
verification.acceptNotes: Closed book cover, open pages, or a stack of books on a table or shelf.
verification.rejectNotes: Phone screen or tablet displaying an ebook.

stops.narrative: As dusk settles across a courtyard, small pools of amber light gather everyone closer.
stops.riddle: I stay silent all afternoon, yet the moment twilight arrives I spill warm amber across the corner of the room. Capture my glow.
stops.actionPrompt: Frame the light source playfully—either cup your hand underneath it as if holding the glow, or shoot from a dramatic low angle.
stops.nudgeHint: Photograph a lit bedside lamp, lantern, candle, fairy lights, or warm light fixture with your hand or a creative angle.

verification.targetDescription: A lit lamp, bulb, lantern, fairy lights, or candle emitting warm light (bonus if framed playfully with a hand or low angle).
verification.acceptNotes: Bedside lamp, standing lamp, decorative lantern, string lights, or candle flame, preferably lit.
verification.rejectNotes: Pitch-black frame or switched-off appliance with no light fixture visible.

stops.narrative: Everything is packed, the doors are open, and the courtyard awaits just beyond the threshold.
stops.riddle: We wait near the doorway in quiet pairs—or jingle in your palm—marking the exact moment you leave home behind for the celebration. Show us before you step out.
stops.nudgeHint: Photograph a pair of shoes/sandals by the door or a set of house/car keys.
stops.successNote: Threshold crossed. Unlocking your final story and keepsake strip now.

verification.targetDescription: A pair of shoes/sandals/footwear or keys (house or vehicle keys).
verification.acceptNotes: Shoes on a mat/rack, footwear worn on feet, or a keyring/keys on a table or in hand.
verification.rejectNotes: Empty floor with no shoes or keys visible.
